title: Fit around the fixed slot
hook: A movable task fits only if it respects the fixed appointment.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Place flexible work around a fixed calendar interval.

objective: Place flexible work around a fixed calendar interval.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A movable task fits only if it respects the fixed appointment. Which placement avoids the fixed call? Correct option: Finish before the call. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: The call is fixed at minute twenty. Only the movable task changes; fitting flexible work requires respecting occupied intervals.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.
